products.short_description: Implement GWMME for Exchange→Gmail migration — install/configure, grant access, build mappings, run batched throttled migrations, and validate mail/calendar/contacts — so mailbox data lands complete. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Migrate Exchange mail to Gmail with GWMME the right way

For mail-focused moves, Google Workspace Migration for Microsoft Exchange (GWMME) pulls mail, calendar, and contacts from Exchange/M365 into Gmail — but it needs the right service account, permissions, and batching. This solution is the GWMME implementation playbook: install and configure GWMME, grant the required Exchange/M365 access, build a mapping/CSV, run batched migrations with throttling awareness, and validate mail/calendar/contacts — so mailbox data lands complete.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what GWMME migrates (mail/calendar/contacts), where it fits vs Workspace Migrate and third-party tools, and its batch model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (GWMME host, Exchange/M365 access + service account, Google access, mapping data, pilot scope).
  • Implementation Guide — install/configure GWMME, grant access, build the mapping/CSV, run a pilot batch, validate, then scale batches — pilot-first; tool internals deferred to Google's GWMME docs, procedure and sequencing given.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (pilot mailboxes complete, calendar/contacts intact, errors triaged) plus Best Practices for reliable batch execution.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Exchange mailboxes moved to Gmail complete and intact — GWMME configured, access granted, batches run and validated — mail, calendar, and contacts all land.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • gwmme_batch_planner.py — throttle-aware wave planner for GWMME migrations
    • gwmme_config_helper.py — mapping/config validator, wave-subset builder, and throttle-budget check
    • gwmme_discovery.py — discover source mailboxes vs. Google target users and emit a mapping skeleton
    • gwmme_prereq_validator.py — validate GWMME prerequisites before installing/running the tool
    • gwmme_validation_report.py — post-migration mail/calendar/contacts completeness report

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
